text: the loop cut one check on, do u not have the normal cut? that only cuts that face ?
resolution: Checked on the loop-cut complaint: basic-cut already does bounded, selection-local subdivision. Measured on region:hood, basic-cut adds +6 tris touching only hood, while cut adds +66 across nine regions. P1-3 in the work order was wrong and has been rewritten as a documentation gap, not a defect - basic-cut's one-line description says nothing about locality, which is why cut got used all session.
